target: Software engineering intern roles at quantitative trading / HFT firms (Jane Street, HRT, Citadel Securities, Optiver, IMC style), 2026–27 cycle. Score domain_fit for this domain.
seven_second_takeaway: UMD CS '28 who built a C++17 IEX order book replaying 50.9M real messages with ns-level latency numbers; AWS and Capital One SWE internships.

score_rationale.impact_clarity: Order book bullets are strong; UMIACS, TerpLabs Redis, Capital One index and AWS (WIP) bullets end without a result.
